result.summary:
CODE-DESIGNER, WF-02 step 1, REQ-001 + REQ-007: design written to docs/design/REQ-001-pixel-office.md (one document, sections 0-14 plus probe appendix P0-P10, about 2,200 lines, 31 tables, no implementation code). Only that file was written in the project; all probes ran in the session scratchpad. Design is NOT yet checked by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR.

ANSWERS (sources: official docs opened 2026-10-01, or probes with command and output in Appendix A):
1. Events: SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop (no matcher) + PostToolUse with matcher Agent. PreToolUse is not needed: PostToolUse(Agent) alone carries tool_input.description, subagent_type, tool_use_id, tool_response.agentId and the caller's agent_id/agent_type. [https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks sections Hook lifecycle, PreToolUse input > Agent; probes P2, P8]
2. Description link: tool_response.agentId (PostToolUse) == agent_id (SubagentStart/Stop), 4 of 4 in probe P2 (format 'a'+16 hex), same on 2.1.286 (P8). Event ORDER differs between versions (2.1.284: SubagentStart before PostToolUse; 2.1.286: after), so link by equality only; no link means no description (AC6 z). Foreground launches get their description only after SubagentStop (2.1.284).
3. Handler: synchronous command, exec form with a guard script, timeout 4. async rejected (-p kills async hooks at teardown, outcome cancelled; timeout not enforced), http rejected (SessionStart supports only command/mcp_tool; failures visible). Probe P6: exit 1 -> outcome error, over timeout -> cancelled. [hooks: Hook handler fields, Run hooks in the background, Timeouts]
4. Node 22 without PATH: the hook inherits the parent env unchanged (P1: PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin). hook.sh tries <state dir>/node-path (recorded by the server) -> PATH node if v22 -> <каталог Homebrew> and /usr/local/opt/node@22/bin -> silent exit 0. Verified here: <каталог Homebrew> is v25.2.1, <каталог Homebrew> is v22.21.1; probe P5 (5 scenarios, 43 ms per run).
5. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR = directory where the session started (sai/), NOT the git root (P1: .../repo/sub vs git root .../repo). A session started in sai/ reads: sai/.claude/settings.json (yes), sai/.claude/settings.local.json (legacy, yes), <общая папка>/.claude/settings.local.json (yes), <общая папка>/.claude/settings.json (NO); user settings per docs; no managed settings, 0 plugin hooks. [https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings 'Where Claude Code keeps the local file in a git repository'; hooks 'Reference scripts by path'; P1]
6. A turn woken by background work DOES fire UserPromptSubmit; prompt starts with <task-notification> (P1, P2, P4, P8). Stop does not mean idle (background_tasks still running). Consequence: the 'main session is processing a request' row also appears for woken turns; AC3 forbids storing a flag, so this is a documented limitation.
7. Telling hook_response apart: stream-json hook_started/hook_response carry no command text and equal hook_name for several handlers. The settings command first writes 'sai-pixel-office' to stderr (invisible to the user on exit 0, arrives in hook_response.stderr, P6) and the UAT also uses --setting-sources project.
8. UAT command: 'claude' is not on PATH; the VS Code extension bundles it at <домашняя папка>/.vscode/extensions/anthropic.claude-code-2.1.284-darwin-arm64/resources/native-binary/claude (2.1.286 is now installed too). Exact command in design section 1.8: env -i ... PATH=/usr/bin:/bin ... "$CLAUDE_BIN" -p "$PROMPT" --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-hook-events --setting-sources project --no-session-persistence --model sonnet --max-budget-usd 2, run from <папка Sai>.

MODULES: tools/src/pixel-office/{config,state-dir,protocol,journal,server,main}.js, hook.sh, hook.js; public/{schema,texts,format,model,app,boot}.js, index.html, style.css, and REQ-007 files layout, office-model, office-sim, office-view, office-report (.js). Data shapes: event line (10 keys), state dir (5 files outside the repo), read API, Task/MainRow/Model, OfficeModel, Card.
